verification.scope: Timing policy and raw conditional heads only. No timing adoption, actual-body transfer, joint completion or full worker/live-audio acceptance.

limits: No timing choice adopted. Omitted setting retains exact at-action evaluation; explicit zero rounds up.
Raw conditional transfer profiles have fixed source-body and issue-prefix assumptions. This does not prove actual-Voice body transfer fidelity or candidate/default consumption.
The maximum-assignment assay uses synthetic acoustic/memory inputs, forced profile assignments and excludes matcher, section, full worker queue, Voice decisions and audio device.
Normal renderer cases are finite regression materials, not calibration, audible benefit or author acceptance.

Shared/local joint runtime ownership and full conditional feature/score update, complete heads, timing adoption, actual-body consumption and whole-worker/Voice/live-audio gates remain open. I10 incomplete; I9 held and I11 effects disabled.

arrival_integration_finding.scope: Existing bounded quadrature phase-resolution gate, observed under optional later evaluation. No change to the arrival algorithm in this experiment.
arrival_integration_finding.condition: The 1-second horizon requires width <= peak.period_seconds / 4 even with zero phase coefficients. At period 0.17174420593226114 s, 16 intervals are still too wide; all 62 evaluations are spent and no point is returned despite constant log(2) hazard.
arrival_integration_finding.next_action: Make the phase-resolution gate depend on actual phase dependence, preserve nonzero phase controls and compare against independent integrals. Separately reduce delayed table rebuild cost; do not adopt a timing setting from receipt counts alone.
